## Code of Conduct

Be respectful, inclusive, and constructive. We're all here to make better tools together.

## Language Policy

**English is the primary language for all communications in this repository.**

This includes:

- Issues and bug reports
- Pull requests and code reviews
- Documentation and comments
- Discussions and community interactions

### Why English?

- **Global Accessibility**: English allows contributors from all regions to collaborate effectively
- **Consistency**: A single language keeps discussions organized and searchable
- **Open Source Best Practice**: Most successful open-source projects use English as the lingua franca

### Need Help with English?

If English isn't your first language, don't worry! We value your contributions regardless of perfect grammar. You can:

- Use translation tools to help compose messages
- Ask for help from other community members
- Focus on clear, simple communication rather than perfect prose

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- **Bun** 1.4.4 (CI-pinned) - The only package manager for the workspace itself
- **Node** 24 - Required for vendored packages (lsp-tools-mcp, lsp-daemon, git-bash-mcp) and the Codex plugin build via npm
- **git** - Version control
- **tmux** (optional) - Enables the `interactive_bash` tool and Team Mode visualization

### Development Setup

```bash
# Clone the repository (with the frontend provenance submodules)
git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent.git
cd oh-my-openagent

# If you cloned without --recurse-submodules, initialize them now (non-fatal offline):
git submodule update --init --recursive

# Install dependencies (bun only - never use npm/yarn)
bun install

# Build the project (materializes the frontend third-party references from the submodules)
bun run build
```

> The frontend skill's brand / taste / ui-ux references are third-party content kept ONLY as pinned git submodules under `packages/shared-skills/upstreams/`. The repo contains zero committed copies; the build materializes them into `packages/shared-skills/skills/frontend/references/` (gitignored locally, shipped in the published package). `script/agent/setup.sh` runs the submodule init + materialize for you (both non-fatal, so an offline checkout still builds, just without the brand refs).

### Testing Your Changes Locally

After making changes, you can test your local build in OpenCode:

1. **Build the project**:

   ```bash
   bun run build
   ```

2. **Update your OpenCode config** (`~/.config/opencode/opencode.json` or `opencode.jsonc`):

   Built dist (after `bun run build`):

   ```json
   {
     "plugin": ["file:///absolute/path/to/oh-my-openagent/dist/index.js"]
   }
   ```

   Source mode (no build needed):

   ```json
   {
     "plugin": ["file:///absolute/path/to/oh-my-openagent/packages/omo-opencode/src/index.ts"]
   }
   ```

   The path must be **absolute** and contain a recognizable project name plus `(src|dist)/index.(ts|js)`. A relative `file://./...` path will not be detected by the installer.

   > **Note**: Remove `"oh-my-openagent"` or `"oh-my-opencode"` from the plugin array if they exist, to avoid conflicts with the npm version.

3. **Restart OpenCode** to load the changes.

4. **Verify** the plugin is loaded by checking for OmO agent availability or startup messages.

name: CI Full Matrix Label

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [dev, master]
    types: [labeled]

# Reusable workflows cannot elevate the caller's token permissions.
# ci.yml's PR guard and push-only jobs declare these write permissions.
permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  # The label costs macOS/Windows runners: the shared platform decision honors it only for a platform path in the diff
  # or a PR body line 'Platform-reason: <why>'. A refused label fails here in seconds, on Linux, before the reusable
  # full matrix schedules anything. These checks are optional; required CI is untouched.
  gate:
    name: Full-matrix label gate
    if: github.event.label.name == 'ci:full-matrix'
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    uses: ./.github/workflows/pr-platform-decision.yml
    with:
      fail-on-refusal: true

  full-matrix:
    needs: gate
    if: github.event.label.name == 'ci:full-matrix'
    # Only matching labels enter this group; bot labels cannot cancel it.
    concurrency:
      group: ${{ github.workflow }}-pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}-full-matrix
      cancel-in-progress: true
    uses: ./.github/workflows/ci.yml

  # master/dev is never cancelled, so the running dev run always finishes (the baseline PR failures are judged
  # against), and GitHub keeps only the newest pending push run, so at most two dev runs exist at a time. PR runs
  # still cancel their superseded run on the same ref.
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name != 'push' }}

  contents: read

  # Job timeouts are about twice each job's measured p95 (25 green PR runs + 12 green dev pushes, 2026-11-22),

          HEAD_COMMIT_MESSAGE: ${{ github.event.head_commit.message || '' }}

name: get.omo.dev CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [master, dev]
    paths:
      - "packages/get-worker/**"
      - "script/installer/**"
      - ".github/workflows/get-worker-ci.yml"
  pull_request:
    branches: [master, dev]
    paths:
      - "packages/get-worker/**"
      - "script/installer/**"
      - ".github/workflows/get-worker-ci.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

permissions:
  contents: read

# Installs from this workflow are tagged so they stay out of the public download count.
env:
  OMO_INSTALL_QA: "1"

jobs:
  platform:
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    uses: ./.github/workflows/pr-platform-decision.yml

  worker:
    runs-on: ubuntu-26.04
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: packages/get-worker
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: "1.4.4"
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Type check
        run: bun run type-check
      - name: Unit tests
        run: bun run test
      - name: shellcheck install.sh
        run: shellcheck scripts/install.sh
      - name: PSScriptAnalyzer install.ps1
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Install-Module PSScriptAnalyzer -Force -Scope CurrentUser
          $findings = Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path scripts/install.ps1 -Severity Error
          $findings | Format-Table -AutoSize
          if ($findings) { exit 1 }
      - name: Bundle dry run
        run: bunx wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
      - name: Write job summary
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        working-directory: .
        env:
          JOB_SUMMARY_TITLE: get.omo.dev worker checks
          JOB_SUMMARY_STATUS: ${{ job.status }}
          JOB_SUMMARY_DETAILS: |
            - Type-checks and unit-tests the get.omo.dev Worker.
            - Lints install.sh with shellcheck and install.ps1 with PSScriptAnalyzer.
            - Bundles the Worker with a wrangler dry run.
          JOB_SUMMARY_NEXT: Start with the first failing step; the install jobs only run after this one passes.
        run: GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY="$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY" bash .github/scripts/write-job-summary.sh

  # Runs the installer from this checkout against the live get.omo.dev, the way users run it.
  install-unix:
    needs: [worker, platform]
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        # macOS/Windows only when the shared platform decision allows it (pr-platform-decision.yml, #13859).
        include: >-
          ${{ fromJSON(needs.platform.outputs.full_matrix != 'true' && '[{"os": "ubuntu-latest", "name": "linux-glibc"},
          {"os": "ubuntu-24.04-arm", "name": "linux-arm64"}]' || '[{"os": "ubuntu-latest", "name": "linux-glibc"},
          {"os": "ubuntu-24.04-arm", "name": "linux-arm64"}, {"os": "macos-latest", "name": "macos-arm64"}]') }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest' && 'ubuntu-26.04' || matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: Install into an isolated HOME, twice
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          expected="$(curl -fsSL https://get.omo.dev/channels/latest | tr -d '[:space:]')"
          HOME="$(mktemp -d)"
          export HOME SHELL=/bin/bash
          bash packages/get-worker/scripts/install.sh 2>&1 | tee first.log
          "$HOME/.local/bin/omo" --version | grep -F "omo ${expected}"
          bash packages/get-worker/scripts/install.sh 2>&1 | tee second.log
          grep -F "is already installed" second.log
          test "$(grep -c 'omo installer >>>' "$HOME/.bashrc" "$HOME/.bash_profile" 2>/dev/null | awk -F: '{s+=$2} END {print s}')" = 1
          grep -F '"method": "standalone"' "$HOME/.omo/install.json"
      - name: Unreachable mirror falls back to npm + GitHub
        if: matrix.name == 'linux-glibc'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          HOME="$(mktemp -d)"
          export HOME
          OMO_INSTALL_BASE_URL=https://get.omo.invalid bash packages/get-worker/scripts/install.sh 2>&1 | tee fallback.log
          grep -F "falling back to GitHub releases" fallback.log
          "$HOME/.local/bin/omo" --version
      - name: Write job summary
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        working-directory: .
        env:
          JOB_SUMMARY_TITLE: get.omo.dev
